text: This might be nothing and I'm only the stepdad so maybe I'm overthinking it. Her mum's on a night shift. Lily's 2. Her eczema has gone mad tonight, dry itchy patches behind her knees and on her arms, and she keeps scratching. The thing that's bugging me is her neck. She won't look down. I tried getting her to look at her belly button and at a toy on her lap and she just won't bend her head forward, keeps it up straight. Her colour's normal, lips look normal. No rash apart from the eczema. I even did the glass thing on the red bits and they went pale. Sorry if this is a daft one
